paddock.title: mullet-paddock
paddock.blurb: Operator control center: React UI + FastAPI gateway. Finds drones from their heartbeats, sends the five semantic actions, and hosts the Mission Builder (ergodic/3, 2D + 3D, previous missions). No mock mode.
paddock.wires: Browser → gateway :8000 → ROS 2 action/service clients → mullet_interfaces → mullet_core. UI at :5173. Start mission gated on a framework READY.

commands.label: Aircraft
lines: # Mission Builder toolbar: Download this area (before leaving Wi-Fi)

interfaces.title: mullet-interfaces
interfaces.blurb: Wire contract only: 3 actions, heartbeat v3, MissionCommand (TRAJECTORY / VELOCITY / ACCELERATION, planar + 3D), MissionStatus, LoadMission, ListMissions. Change order: IDL → core populates → paddock reads.
interfaces.wires: Consumed by core, paddock (vendored), sitl_sim (submodule), and mission frameworks.

core.title: mullet-core
core.blurb: Soft real-time PX4 offboard supervisor. Four states: IDLE, TRANSITION, HOLD, MISSION. Owns takeoff, land, RTH and MissionCommand validation. PX4 stays hard RT; RC kill is the e-stop.
core.wires: Serves <ns>/{takeoff,land,return_home} and <ns>/{start_mission,hold}. Publishes /mullet/heartbeat. Streams <ns>/command to PX4 only in MISSION. Aircraft = instance 0: bare names, uav_0.

commands.label: Aircraft
lines: cd docker && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d --build
ros2 action send_goal /takeoff mullet_interfaces/action/Takeoff "{altitude_m: 2.0, yaw_rad: 0.0, use_current_yaw: true}" --feedback

ergodic.title: ergodic_mppi
ergodic.blurb: JAX MPPI ergodic coverage as a MULLET mission framework. Loads ergodic/3 specs (trajectory mode by default), keeps a mission library, streams MissionCommand. Never talks to /fmu/in/*.
ergodic.wires: paddock LoadMission → ergodic_mission → MissionCommand → mullet_core → PX4. Status + preflight on /mullet/mission_status @ 2 Hz.

commands.label: SITL
lines: docker run --rm --network host -e ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42 ergodic-mission:latest python /workspace/tests/sitl/sitl_e2e.py --drone uav_1

commands.label: Aircraft
lines: ssh orin 'cd ergodic_mppi && git pull --recurse-submodules && cd docker/mission && cp -n .env.example .env && docker compose up -d --build'

px4.title: PX4
px4.blurb: Hard real-time flight controller. Attitude, mixing, motors, failsafes. uXRCE-DDS to ROS 2. Emergency stop is the RC kill switch.
px4.wires: Pixhawk TELEM3 serial on the aircraft (TELEM2 on the SIH bench board); UDP in SITL. Domain: UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID = ROS_DOMAIN_ID.

ros_base.title: mullet-base
ros_base.blurb: ARM64 ROS 2 Jazzy base for Jetson Orin (JetPack 6.2.2). CUDA 13.2 + compat, px4_msgs 1.17, Micro XRCE-DDS Agent v2.4.2. Pin v0.5.1+, never :main on aircraft.
ros_base.wires: FROM ghcr.io/skymule-ai/mullet-base:v0.5.1 — consumed by mullet-core and ergodic mission images.

commands.label: Orin
lines: MULLET_ROS_IMAGE_TAG=v0.5.1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.jetson.yml run --rm ros2-base

sitl_sim.title: mullet-sim
sitl_sim.blurb: Multi-vehicle PX4 SITL + Gazebo + ROS 2. One container, N vehicles, host tmux or headless. Paddock's live backend and the frameworks' e2e target.
sitl_sim.wires: PX4 SITL image built from image/ (ghcr.io/skymule-ai/px4-sitl:v1.17.0, lockstep with px4_msgs release/1.17). Submodules: mullet-core, mullet-interfaces. Headless paddock.yaml → uav_1 / uav_2 on domain 42.

commands.label: PX4 image
lines: git tag -a px4-v1.17.0 -m "Release PX4 v1.17.0" && git push origin px4-v1.17.0
